children: HIVE Digital Technologies announced a strategic partnership whereby BUZZ HPC will provide dedicated Canadian GPU capacity to ProCogia and the firms will co-sell sovereign AI solutions internationally.
BUZZ HPC will supply dedicated accelerated GPU capacity from its Canadian data centers to ProCogia to power ProCogia's AI products and client workloads.
ProCogia will become a preferred applied-AI services partner for BUZZ HPC customers, offering LLM hosting, bespoke training, agents and vertical AI products.
The companies intend to jointly market and co-sell their sovereign compute plus applied-AI offering to enterprise and SMB customers in the U.S. and Europe.
ProCogia will deploy its ZeroBoxx AI framework and vertical products (CallYeah, PolyKode) on BUZZ HPC's Canadian sovereign infrastructure as anchor workloads.
Partnership aligns with Canadian priorities to expand domestic hardware and compute access, enabling governed AI without surrendering data sovereignty.
